name: Kettlebell Swing
description: A powerful hip hinge: swing the kettlebell back between your legs, then snap your hips forward so it floats up to chest height.

source.note: Standard exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips, kettlebell held in both hands.
cues: It's a hinge, not a squat: push your hips back.
Drive with your hips; your arms just guide the bell.
Stand tall at the top with your glutes squeezed.
Learn it with a light bell first.

prescription.note: Explosive hips, controlled arms. Stop the set before your form fades.

keyframes.name: Hike back
keyframes.cue: Hinge and swing the bell back between your legs.

keyframes.name: Swing up
keyframes.cue: Snap your hips forward; the bell floats to chest height.
